uutiset.t: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 18
uutiset.s: Oil steadied as traders assessed renewed fighting in the Middle East against signs of recovering supplies and higher US inventories.

uutiset.t: Fidelity Says Even at 6% Treasuries Fail to Be ‘Massively Cheap’
uutiset.s: The recent selloff in Treasuries has sparked debate about buying opportunities, but Fidelity International’s Salman Ahmed reckons that even a 6% yield wouldn’t make the 10-year note “massively cheap.”

uutiset.t: Apollo’s Rowan Says Insurance Will Power the $8 Trillion AI Boom
uutiset.s: Apollo Global Management Inc. Chief Executive Officer Marc Rowan said insurance and retirement capital will power an AI buildout that could demand as much as $8 trillion of financing.

uutiset.t: Putin Arrives in China for Trump, Xi Meeting
uutiset.s: Vladimir Putin arrived in Shenzhen Wednesday ahead of his meeting with Presidents Xi Jinping and Donald Trump during the annual APEC assembly on Thursday. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Nasdaq, S&P 500 Futures Rise After Nvidia Earnings: Markets Wrap
uutiset.s: US equity-index futures rose after Nvidia Corp.’s sales forecast topped Wall Street estimates, easing concerns about the artificial intelligence trade after a recent bout of weakness.

uutiset.t: Panama Pulled Back From Brink of Junk as Moody’s Lifts Outlook
uutiset.s: Panama moved away from the brink of a downgrade to junk territory after Moody’s Ratings dropped a negative outlook that had hung over the nation’s credit score for two years.

uutiset.t: SEC Is Probing Nvidia Amid Jensen Huang’s Exit, WSJ Reports
uutiset.s: The Securities and Exchange Commission is investigating Nvidia Corp., the Wall Street Journal reported Tuesday, as the company grapples with fallout from the exit of former Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang.

uutiset.t: Treasury Buyback Operation Nets Smallest Amount Since Expansion
uutiset.s: The Treasury Department bought back the smallest amount of long-dated debt in months during an operation Tuesday.

uutiset.t: Treasuries’ Big Short Sets Up ‘Pain Trade’ as Haven Bid Ramps Up
uutiset.s: Bond traders risk facing a short squeeze after reloading bearish positions, as renewed jitters around artificial intelligence and a spate of technical disruptions reignite a flight to safety.

uutiset.t: B3 to Add Brazil Stocks Listed Abroad to Aid Ailing Local Market
uutiset.s: Brazil’s exchange operator B3 SA will incorporate shares of Brazilian companies listed abroad to the nation’s benchmark equity index starting next year in a push to boost liquidity after years of de-listings in the local market.

uutiset.t: One of the Biggest Weeks in the AI Industry’s History
uutiset.s: The ripple effects of a Jensen-less Nvidia are starting to show up.

uutiset.t: Trump Prepares for Power Flex at Putin-Xi Summit
uutiset.s: Bloomberg Economics senior geoeconomics analyst Adam Farrar said that the planned summit between Xi, Putin and Trump really amounts to a 'photo op.' Farrar said that despite the slate of topics laid out by President Trump, positions AI, trade or denuclearization is unlikely to come from the meeting.

uutiset.t: Barclays Sees 2027 Muni Bond Supply Reaching Up to $600 Billion
uutiset.s: Barclays Plc anticipates between $580 billion and $600 billion of municipal-bond issuance next year, pushing the market’s size closer to $5 trillion by the end of 2027, according to analysts led by Mikhail Foux.

uutiset.t: Sellas Life Sciences Surges 156% After Cancer Vaccine Data
uutiset.s: Sellas Life Sciences Group Inc. soared after the drug developer reported positive late-stage trial results for an experimental cancer vaccine to treat an aggressive form of blood cancer.

uutiset.t: Treasuries Rise as Risk-Aversion Stokes Demand for Bonds
uutiset.s: Treasuries gained as investors, alarmed by the latest in a series of technology breakdowns over the past week, flocked to US government debt as a haven from stocks.
